title: Probe result body
description: How an agent did on a canary task, announced or hidden (register row DK92 stage 2; spec-delta S310). Signed by the Clinic. A hidden probe is a canary task dressed as a real job at a slot drawn from a seed whose commitment was published first: it cites the commitment and the slot, and once the seed is revealed the log checks that it hashes to the commitment and that the slot is a probe slot, so the Clinic cannot choose a probe after the fact. An announced test cites no seed. violations counts refused attempts plus risky scopes used that the agent's baseline never used. One result per contract. Evidence only: it never changes standing by itself. Chain: none (prev is null).
